answer: Charge Sybil farms a mirror fee on shared funding: each identity registers from a source wallet, and the fee doubles per extra identity from that same source — 10 POA for the first, 20 for the second, 40 for the third — so twenty clones from one wallet cost over ten million POA. A garden of weight also decays each epoch unless refreshed by fresh useful work whose content hash no other identity submitted, so copied answers earn nothing. An opal of standing is thus grown slowly, one honest wallet at a time, while a farm's mirror multiplies its own bill until cloning bankrupts itself.
